notes: read as two routes from Hammad: one through Thabit, one through Sa'id al-Jurayri (introduced by «وسعيد الجريري»); each route writes its own Mutarrif and Imran, so the tail is null and the shared head is written in both groups
«وقال أحدهما يومين» is the two routes' wording difference: left out
